deviations.why: Testimonial data is not available in the Vitrina data contract and the section policy forbids inventing testimonials.
There is no real booking flow provided in the data contract; including a form would be misleading.
No years of experience data is available in the intake; it would be fabricated.

deviations.what: Timeline section uses d.services as entries; dates are omitted
deviations.why: No dedicated timeline data exists in the contract; d.services provides title and description suitable for adaptation.

notes: Faithful port of Medic Care template with all visible text either bound to Vitrina data or Greek structural labels. The hero uses scroll-snap instead of JavaScript carousel. Colors mapped to CSS variables in .root; --vt-accent-on-deep darkened to meet contrast requirements against --vt-surface-deep.
